newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish 1996 grain crop up 11 pct, sugar beet down.
newsitem.headline: Finnish 1996 grain crop up 11 pct, sugar beet down.

text.p: Finland's total 1996 grain crop was 11 percent up on last year at an above-average 3.7 million tonnes, the Ministry of Forestry and Agriculture said on Monday.
But sugarbeet output fell some 20 percent to 897 million kg, and the potato crop fell four percent to 770 million, it said.
Barley yields totalled 1.86 million tonnes, up five percent on 1995, and oat yields rose 14 percent to 1.26 million tonnes, it added in a statement.
The fodder crop rose nine percent, in line with the increase in areas cultivated, to 3.16 million tonnes.
The bread grain crop totalled 546 million kg, up 109 million with wheat yields well above average.
"Before threshing, there were hopes for top yields in some areas but the harvested volumes turned out slightly below estimates," the ministry said.
The season was characterised by a cold, damp early summer and a hot dry August, and the main reason for the increase in output was a 100,000 hectare expansion of area, it said.
